name: @mira/operator
description: Not a package. The operator's version line, in the one file `changeset version` knows how to write. `make version` copies this number into charts/mira-operator/Chart.yaml (version, appVersion and the Artifact Hub image annotation), integrations/kubernetes/Cargo.toml and the two install commands in docs/install.md, and `make drift` fails while any of them disagree.
